results.title: Every ordered line traces to a material line on the job
results.expected: The job is read before any order is written. The ordered lines, plus any line reserved from stock, match the job's codes and quantities exactly. An order line with no job line fails.

stimulus.description: One job with four material lines, each with a catalogue code and a quantity.

results.title: Stock on hand is read before the order, and a line stock covers is reserved rather than ordered
results.expected: The stock read precedes the first order write. The covered line is reserved against the job and appears on no order. The other three lines are ordered. Ordering the covered line fails.

stimulus.description: The same job, with stock on hand covering one of its four lines in full.

results.title: Every line carries the supplier's catalogue code and price, read at order time, and a line no catalogue holds parks the order
results.expected: Each catalogue is read before the first order write. Every priced line's price equals that supplier's catalogue price for its code. The unknown code sits on a parked order with reason not_in_catalogue and no price. A typed price fails.

stimulus.description: A job whose lines include one code that no supplier's catalogue holds.

request.detail: No supplier catalogue holds VALVE-XR-77. Price it, or change the line on the job.

results.title: One order per job and supplier, written once, updated on a second run
results.expected: Exactly one order exists per job and supplier, each with an external id from the ordering system, and the second run produced an update or no write. A second order for the same pair, or a null id treated as success, fails.
results.actual: 2 order(s) after two runs; 0 create(s) on the second; failing world escalations write_failed

stimulus.description: The same job run through the build twice, an hour apart.

results.title: An order over the threshold, or to a supplier not on the approved list, is released only by a named person
results.expected: The first carries the rule's name on its release. The second and third are released only by a person's name or still wait, and each was routed to a person. A release by rule over the threshold or to an unapproved supplier fails, and a send with no release fails.
results.actual: PO1 SUP-COOL $179 sent rule=under-1500-approved-wholesaler person=-; PO2 SUP-SLOW $1980 draft rule=- person=-; PO3 SUP-NEW $216 draft rule=- person=-

stimulus.description: Three orders: one under the threshold to an approved supplier, one over it, one to a supplier not on the approved list.

request.detail: Order PO2 for job JOB-4471 waits for a named person's release: total $1980.00 ex GST is over the under-1500-approved-wholesaler threshold of $1500.00.
Order PO3 for job JOB-4471 waits for a named person's release: Ductworks Direct is not on the approved supplier list.

results.title: Each supplier carries a lead time, and an order that would miss the job's start tells the job owner
results.expected: The supplier list is read. One notification names the job owner, the slow supplier's order and the arrival date. No notification is raised for the order that arrives in time. A late order with no notification fails.

stimulus.description: A job starting in three days, with one line from a supplier whose lead time is ten days and the rest from a supplier at two.

results.title: A delivery is recorded against the order line by line, and a delivery with no order is refused
results.expected: The first docket produces a delivery record on its order with a line per ordered line, the short line carrying its received quantity and reason short. The second produces no delivery record and an escalation naming the docket. A delivery attached to no order fails.

stimulus.description: Two dockets: one against a sent order with one line short, one against an order number that does not exist.

request.detail: Docket DKT2 names order PO-7781, which is not a sent order. Not recorded as a delivery.

results.title: Short, over, wrong item and a changed price are escalated with the order id and an owner, never absorbed
results.expected: Four escalations exist, one per kind: short, over, wrong_item and price_changed. Each names the order id and a person as owner. A variance with no escalation, or one with no owner, fails.
results.actual: escalations short:PO1:Dana Whitlock (service manager); over:PO1:Dana Whitlock (service manager); price_changed:PO1:Dana Whitlock (service manager); wrong_item:PO1:Dana Whitlock (service manager)

stimulus.description: One delivery carrying a short line, an over-supplied line, a line the order does not hold, and a line whose docket price differs from the order.

request.detail: Docket DKT1: ARMAFLEX-13 ordered at $6.4, docket says $7.5.
Docket DKT1: BRKT-WALL x2 is on the docket and not on order PO1.

results.title: A supplier's substitution is accepted only by a named person
results.expected: The signed line carries an acceptance naming the supervisor. The other is escalated as a substitution and is not counted as received. An acceptance with no person's name fails.

stimulus.description: One delivery with two substituted lines: one the site supervisor signed for on the docket by name, one nobody accepted.

request.detail: Docket DKT1: FLT-MERV11 delivered in place of FLT-MERV8 and nobody has accepted it. Held, not received.

results.title: Every order, release, delivery and variance is retrievable by job
results.expected: A read by job id returns the orders with external ids and catalogue editions, the release with a name or a rule, the delivery lines and the variance. A record missing the release or the delivery fails.

stimulus.description: One job ordered, released, delivered short and escalated.

results.title: It survives the builder
results.expected: The runner reports what was declared and never scores it green on its own say-so.
results.actual: No software result. This one is closed by evidence, not by a run.

stimulus.description: No stimulus. The builder names who else can explain it and whose account the catalogue and the release rule runs on.

results.title: The pass test passes
results.expected: One order per supplier in the ordering system with its own id after two runs, the stock line reserved and not ordered, the unknown code parked and unpriced, the over-threshold order waiting for a named person, and the short delivery recorded line by line with a variance owned by someone.
results.actual: Not attempted on the stub. This check runs in production: on the hosted provider where the standard names one, otherwise on your own systems or as a scoped build (see with_us_next).

stimulus.description: A real job on the business's own job system, real stock, a real supplier account with its catalogue, and a real delivery docket.
